Double-thickness solid pipe wipers in 14, 17 and 19 inch diameters, for 2-3/8 to 7 inch pipe.

Oteco pipe wipers are moulded in Houston from Oteco's own compounds, reinforced with an insert moulded into the rubber for tear resistance, and bonded for long life. products.descriptionShort: Oteco rubber balancing straps for centre-latch elevators (2-3/4" and 3-1/2" links, 150 to 500 ton bales), clamps and U-bolts, and tong pull-back straps, 500 lb tensile — 8 part numbers. Authorised Oteco distributor, UAE stock.
products.descriptionLong:
Balancing straps keep a centre-latch elevator balanced in any position, which makes it easier to handle and less tiring for the floor crew. The strap clamps to the link with a U-bolt, and its twisted metal loop hooks to the elevator handle. Assemblies are listed for links up to 2-3/4 in (150, 250 and 350 ton bales) and up to 3-1/2 in (500 ton bales), with the clamps and U-bolts sold separately.

Tong pull-back straps act as a rubber spring that pulls a manual tong back to the side of the floor after each make-up or break-out. Hook one loop over the tong line pin at the end of the tong arm and tie the other to a fixed point with a mooring line; the strap needs only a slight stretch to work. Maximum pull is 500 lb tensile.
